[[Zone|Rezone]] after killing the bosses and their [[mob]]s. == Collectors == {{:Merin Trollsbane/Collector}} {{:Trego Stonebreaker/Collector}} {{:Trego Stonebreaker/Collector armor}} {{:Nicholas the Traveler/Collector|7th March 2011 and 10th February 2014|Talus Chute|5 [[Mountain Troll Tusk]]s}} == Notes == * The collectors [[Merin Trollsbane]] and [[Trego Stonebreaker]] trade 5 Mountain Troll Tusks for items that sell for 125 {{gold}} to a merchant.
